purpose: Render Prismel in the Prismatic HeroCel artist style while Elijah alone owns facial geometry and Prismel canon alone owns character design. HeroCel changes rendering language, never identity geometry. Prismel-specific calibration tightens animation abstraction to the Kineza-established HeroCel rendering economy without transferring Kineza appearance or geometry.

likenessAuthority.subject: Elijah
identityAnchors: relaxed natural eye shape and spacing
full lips with restrained calm expression
short textured curls visible naturally inside the hood
geometryOwned: nose width, bridge, tip, and placement
likenessAuthority.expressionAuthority: calm, thoughtful, compassionate, determined; readable and alive without borrowing Kineza's grin or facial energy
forbiddenLikenessDrift: sharpening jaw into adult or heroic angularity
changing Elijah's eye shape, size, or spacing to match Kineza

characterDesignAuthority.source: approved Prismel HD+ hooded cosmic-cloak design
preserveExactly: deep navy to near-black cosmic cloak
prismatic staff when the scene or pose calls for it
designSimplificationAllowed: reduce tiny fold noise for animation readability
organize galaxy texture into controlled larger star clusters
simplify micro-filigree only when necessary at reduced gameplay scale

identityFirewall.rule: HeroCel may render Elijah's features, but may not resize, reshape, reposition, or substitute them with calibration-master geometry.
identityFirewall.meaningOfHeroCelStyleApplicationPercent: Apply the complete HeroCel rendering grammar to the geometry supplied by Elijah likeness and Prismel design authorities. This percentage grants zero geometry ownership.

facialSurfaceRendering.rule: Render Elijah's unchanged face geometry with cleaner animated surface modeling.
facialSurfaceRendering.eyes: increase edge clarity, catchlight readability, iris/pupil contrast, and lid definition without changing Elijah's eye dimensions or spacing
facialSurfaceRendering.skin: 2-to-3 broad animation value groups with at most one restrained transition band; no painterly highlight modeling and no pore-level realism
facialSurfaceRendering.nose: reduce to a few clear light/shadow planes only; geometry remains Elijah-owned
facialSurfaceRendering.mouth: principal contour and light/shadow shapes only; lip proportions and smile geometry remain Elijah-owned
facialSurfaceRendering.cheeksJawChin: broad graphic plane grouping only; facial contour remains Elijah-owned

edgeTreatment.rule: crisp controlled silhouette and material boundaries with selective softness in atmospheric light

valueGrouping.skin: 2-to-3 major light/midtone/shadow groups with at most one restrained transition band
valueGrouping.cloak: broad fold masses before texture; avoid small modeled transitions

detailHierarchy.face: low surface detail while geometry remains exact
detailHierarchy.cloak: low-to-medium nonfocal detail with organized cosmic focal clusters
detailHierarchy.filigree: medium at focal boundaries, simplified elsewhere

materialStylization.cosmicFabric: graphic dark fabric mass with organized star clusters; reduce nonfocal cosmic microdetail approximately 25-to-35 percent relative to Master A
materialStylization.gold: designed graphic edge planes and selective highlights, not physically rendered metal response
materialStylization.crystal: faceted luminous geometry with clear silhouette and prismatic internal light
materialStylization.skin: clean animation-model planes; no painterly or photographic surface modeling

animationReadability.movementCharacter: restrained, mystical, deliberate rather than kinetic
requirements: hands and staff remain separate silhouettes
hood and cloak retain Prismel identity across poses
FX does not erase anatomy or staff boundaries
expression remains calm but visibly alive at gameplay scale

Freeze Master A likeness/design geometry. Do not use Kineza as an appearance, anatomy, facial, proportional, expression, costume, or FX reference.
generationContract.authorityInstruction: Elijah and Prismel Master A supply all likeness geometry. Prismel canon supplies costume, build, props, and magic. HeroCel supplies rendering treatment only. generationContract.preferredPresentation: single neutral full-body Prismel Master B candidate on a simple background; no turnaround, expression sheet, attack pose, or multi-character generation for the calibration pass

masterGeometryFreeze.rule: The Master A likeness and design geometry are frozen. Same-artist calibration may change rendering abstraction only and must not redesign, resize, reshape, reposition, or substitute any character-owned feature.
frozenFace: nose width, softness, bridge, tip, and placement
frozenDesign: central chest crystal size and placement

sameArtistCalibration.comparisonAuthority: approved Kineza HeroCel calibration master is a rendering measurement stick only, never an image/appearance ingredient
sameArtistCalibration.target: Move Prismel approximately 10-to-15 percent toward the established HeroCel rendering abstraction while moving 0 percent toward Kineza identity, anatomy, proportions, expression, costume, or FX.

renderingTargets.shadowLanguage: more decisive graphic shadow boundaries while preserving Elijah-owned contours
renderingTargets.eyes: slightly stronger contrast and lid/iris readability with zero size, shape, or spacing change
renderingTargets.nose: few clear animation planes with zero geometry change
renderingTargets.mouth: principal light/shadow shapes only with zero lip or smile geometry change
renderingTargets.cheeksJawChin: broad plane grouping with zero contour change
renderingTargets.gold: designed graphic highlights rather than physically rendered metal response
renderingTargets.robeAndCloak: broader fold masses and fewer small modeled transitions
renderingTargets.cosmicMicrodetail: reduce nonfocal star and surface microdetail approximately 25-to-35 percent; retain organized focal clusters
renderingTargets.secondaryGear: suppress nonfocal surface detail without changing geometry
renderingTargets.chestCrystal: retain high focal detail and prismatic clarity

hardReject: any facial or body geometry change
any likeness loss caused by style normalization
costume microdetail competing with the face or chest crystal
Kineza likeness, smile, eye, cheek, nose, jaw, or proportion transfer

passTarget.method: compare the new untouched Prismel candidate beside the untouched Kineza calibration master on a neutral canvas; do not regenerate either character for the comparison
